public_finding: Reactive T cells were single-cell sorted and sequenced for their TCR
Reported EC50 range was 1-500 nM for MAGE-A1 96-104:HLA-A*03:01 candidates
Lead TCRs showed activation-marker upregulation and cytokine secretion across multiple donors
No responses were observed when target cells lacked MAGE-A1 or HLA-A*03:01
Efficient target-cell lysis was reported at low effector-to-target ratios
MAGE-A1-specific TCR-T cells controlled tumor growth and extended survival versus control TCR-T cells
